name: North Carolina
summary_text: The archetype of legislative instability: HB 2 (2016) restricted bathrooms to birth-certificate sex and was repealed in 2017 after mass backlash, but a binary-“sex” statute remains. Trans-murder monitoring data places North Carolina at about 3.0 killings per 100k trans women — a recorded floor, mid-pack among states with documented killings — and the July 2026 legal-risk map classifies it moderate-risk (alongside Alaska and Kentucky). Below the national score 0.36.

sources.title: Safe States Don’t Make People Safer
sources.claim_summary: The Needle investigative essay (16 July 2026): a national data analysis comparing legal-risk tiers with Trans Murder Monitoring kill records, arguing protective statutes do not predict lower lethal risk for trans women; includes a state rate chart in which North Carolina stands at 3.0 killings per 100k trans women with 3+ recorded victims (an acknowledged undercount) and characterises North Carolina as moderate-risk.
